description:
Capital Technology Group provides expert consulting services software development, digital transformation, human-centered design, data analytics and visualization, and cybersecurity.  

 Our multidisciplinary teams use agile methodologies to rapidly and incrementally deliver value in close collaboration with our clients. For over a decade, we have been trusted by both federal and commercial clients to solve complex, mission-critical business challenges. The quality of our work has been recognized by our partners and peers through our inclusion in the Digital Services Coalition, a group of forward- thinking firms recognized for excellence in delivering IT services.

 Client Requirements: applicants MUST BE US Citizens and be able to obtain Public Trust clearance

 The CTG Experience 

 At Capital Technology Group (CTG), our teams are passionate about modernizing how the federal government delivers software. We partner with federal agencies to build secure, scalable, and mission-driven solutions that make a meaningful impact on millions of people. Recognized by The Washington Post as a Top Workplace in 2025 and 2026. CTG fosters a culture rooted in our core values. Our values guide how we work together and support one another, creating an environment where employees feel trusted, empowered, and encouraged to grow both personally and professionally.

 About the Role 

 CTG is seeking a Full Stack Engineer to design, develop, and deliver scalable, secure, mission-driven solutions supporting federal modernization initiatives. This role focuses on full-stack development across applications, integrations, cloud environments, APIs, and enterprise systems while partnering closely with engineering, product, infrastructure, and delivery teams.

 You Will Get To 

 
 Design, develop, test, and maintain end-to-end solutions across applications, integrations, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise platforms

 Translate business and product requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions

 Collaborate with engineering, DevSecOps, infrastructure, and product teams on solution design and delivery

 Contribute to technical design discussions, code reviews, and architecture decisions

 Develop backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and Ruby on Rails, and frontend applications using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript 

 Build APIs, integrations, and data flows using REST, GraphQL, Kafka, SQL, Python, and Databricks

 Develop automated tests using JUnit, Jest, and Cypress, while supporting manual testing and quality assurance

 Contribute to CI/CD and deployment processes

 Build and deploy applications on AWS

 Apply secure coding and engineering best practices, while identifying technical risks, performance considerations, and scalability needs

 
 Who You Are 

 
 A hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building scalable, reliable systems

 Strong in full-stack development, application integration, and cloud-based solutions

 Comfortable translating business requirements into practical technical solutions and making thoughtful engineering tradeoffs

 A strong communicator who collaborates effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders

 Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a mission-driven environment

 
 Qualifications 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience)

 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, systems architecture, or solutions architecture roles

 Strong experience designing enterprise application architectures and scalable distributed systems

 Deep hands-on experience with Java, Groovy, Spring Boot, OpenJDK, GraphQL, REST APIs, MySQL, and PostgreSQL 

 Strong frontend architecture experience with Angular, React, TypeScript, and JavaScript 

 Strong understanding of application integration, API design, microservices, event-driven architecture, and enterprise solution patterns

 Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS 

 Familiarity with DevSecOps workflows, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure collaboration, and modern delivery practices

 Knowledge of secure application architecture, API security, and enterprise design best practices

 Strong documentation, architecture communication, and stakeholder leadership skills

 
 Nice to Have 

 
 Experience with DevOps practices, including CI/CD, containerization, Docker, Kubernetes, serverless architectures, or platform engineering

 Experience supporting federal government agencies

 
 Salary 

 We are committed to offering a competitive salary for this position, with an estimated range of $90k–$130k annually . Please note that this range is intended to provide a general idea of what to expect. The final offer may vary based on experience, skills, and other factors.
 
 Full Time Employee Benefits

 
 
 Remote Work (Hybrid roles will be specified in the job post) 

 Competitive Compensation Package

 Medical, Dental, and Vision

 Life Insurance, Short/Long Term Disability

 Employee Assistance Program

 401(k) with 4% matching

 Liberal PTO vacation policy

 Generous Annual Continuing Education

 Annual Wellness Budget

 Bonus Incentive Programs (Employee referrals and performance-based rewards) 

 
 Thanks for your interest in Capital Technology Group! 

 Capital Technology Group is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
